name: Badge
summary: A small pill for a status, a count or a short label.
description: Use badges for read-only information such as Paid, Draft or a count. For labels people can remove or select, use a tag.

classes.name: v-badge
classes.description: The badge. On its own it is neutral grey.

classes.name: v-badge-solid
classes.description: Filled with the accent, for the one badge that should stand out.

classes.name: v-badge-dot
classes.description: Adds a leading dot in the badge's colour.

a11y: The text carries the meaning; tone colour only supports it, so "Overdue" still reads in greyscale.
A count badge next to an icon needs context for screen readers, e.g. a .v-sr-only "unread messages" after the number.
Every tone holds 4.5:1 text contrast in all directions and both themes.
